config.experiment: 026-final-run/r1r4: docs/11 (D-020) challenges R1 (generality across backbones) and R4 (scaling with data), with the addendum (on-disk backbones only). All constants frozen before any real result was read.
config.protocol_source: experiments/020-attr-foundation/run.py imported by path (folds_ha1_main.json, closed_task = T-mix LR probe with inner-CV C, cluster_weights, boot_conf, gate_permutation ...)
config.image_pipeline: data/processed/fov512/images/<sha>.png (512x512, identical for every class) -> lib/perturb.apply_condition(img, cond, key=sha256, seed=0) (same call as 004/023) -> each model's input transform (below)

dinov2.transform: lib Backbone.to_tensor: 224 centre crop (no resize), ImageNet norm; HF facebook/dinov2-base hidden_states 1..12 (pre final LayerNorm), exactly the 004 pipeline with layers=1..12

clip_openai.transform: 224 centre crop (no resize), CLIP norm; OpenAI ViT-L/14 (third_party/CLIP, ViT-L-14.pt, float32); output of each visual.transformer.resblocks[i]

clip_laion.transform: 224 centre crop (no resize), CLIP norm; open_clip ViT-L-14 weights CLIP-ViT-L-14-CommonPool.XL (local safetensors); output of each visual.transformer.resblocks[i]

bfree.transform: 224 centre crop (no resize), B-Free norm (resnet/ImageNet); B-Free's own Wrapper5crops path: the 16x16 token grid is replicate-wrapped to its 36x36 window (scorers.bfree._fwd, the five windows coincide); CLS + 4 register tokens skipped for the mean; output of each timm block

commfor.transform: Community Forensics native test transform (Resize(440) -> CenterCrop(384) -> ImageNet norm): the checkpoint has 384-px position embeddings, so a 224 crop is not possible; documented deviation; output of each timm block

extract.oom_retry: halve the batch on torch.cuda.OutOfMemoryError; at batch 1 wait 20 s and retry (never CPU)

d008.metric: max over conditions, blocks, CLS/mean parts, features of |F_gpu - F_cpu| / max(1, max_i |F_cpu_ij|) (scaled per feature column over the 32 images)
d008.tolerance: max(1e-3, 2 x spread) where spread = the same metric between the two CPU runs A and B (different thread count and batch composition) on the same 32 images; abort the backbone if GPU-vs-CPU(A) or GPU-vs-CPU(B) exceeds it

probe.note: closed_task of 020 unchanged: LR(max_iter 300, balanced) on standardised [CLS|mean] of ONE block, C in the 020 dino grid by inner 3-fold grouped CV on the train folds (scored at jpeg75_resize05), trained on clean+jpeg75_resize05+social_sim, tested at all 5 conditions

config.mid_note: relative depth = block index (1-based) / L; mid = 0.25 <= depth <= 0.75 inclusive (L=12: blocks 3..9; L=24: blocks 6..18)

r1_rule.primary_selection: nested: per outer fold the mid block with the best inner-CV bacc (train folds only; ties -> earlier block), pooled out-of-fold, compared with the LAST block (fixed, no selection) by a paired cluster bootstrap on the same weights
r1_rule.sensitivity_selection: oracle: mid block with the highest test point bacc (optimistic, selected on test; reported only)
r1_rule.satisfied: gap point >= 0.10 AND paired CI lower bound > 0, at jpeg75_resize05
r1_rule.overall: general if >= 3 of the 4 non-reference backbones satisfied; not general if <= 1; else partly general
r1_rule.frozen_pair: general across pretrained backbones iff both clip_openai and clip_laion satisfied (one: 'one of two'; none: 'no')
r1_rule.headline: per backbone: nested over ALL blocks (inner CV) and nested over mid blocks; paired difference to DINOv2-base nested-all

perm.note: 020 ha1_main tolerances; label-permuted fixed-C T-mix pipeline at the primary condition, per backbone, on the middle block

parity.note: fresh GPU features of DINOv2-base blocks 4/8/12 vs the cached 004/016/019 features (scaled max diff); the probe on the cached features must reproduce 020 results.json tmix|b4,b8,b12 exactly (harness check); the probe on the fresh features is compared with it (|dbacc| reported)

r4.subsample: for each outer fold, from that fold's TRAINING rows, n images per generator drawn uniformly (rng [seed, 7001, s, n, fold], same draw for every model => paired); every caption family holds at most one image of a given generator, so the draw is a draw of n caption families per generator; 'all' = every training row (deterministic); the test fold is untouched
r4.probe: same T-mix probe; C by inner 3-fold grouped CV on the subsample (scored at jpeg75_resize05)

models.dinov2: block = most frequent outer-fold inner-CV choice among the mid blocks (ties -> higher mean inner bacc)
models.best_nonref: the non-reference backbone with the highest mean over outer folds of the inner-CV bacc of its nested-all choice (train folds only); block = most frequent nested-all choice

r4.n_eff: n for the fit = mean number of training images per generator actually used (all levels)
r4.fit: error = 1 - bacc(jpeg75_resize05, pooled over folds, mean over the 5 subsamples) = a * n^-b + c by scipy.optimize.curve_fit, bounds a in [0,1e4], b in [0,5], c in [0,1]
r4.bootstrap: 1000 replicates: caption-family cluster weights (same as R1) for the test side AND resampling of the 5 subsamples per n with replacement; CI = percentile 95%
r4.plateau: CI of b includes 0 iff its 2.5th percentile <= 0.05 (b is bounded below by 0, so a flat curve gives a percentile near, not exactly at, the bound; n^-0.05 changes by <9% over n = 15..96, i.e. indistinguishable from flat). Fixed in the selftest stage, before any real result.
r4.caveat: 5 points, 3 parameters, n <= ~96: extrapolation to 1,000 / 10,000 is 10x / 100x outside the data; the CI covers sampling noise only, not misspecification of the power law

grouped_splits.note: committed folds_ha1_main.json == make_folds == rows; check_grouped_folds ok; assert_disjoint_groups runs inside every closed_task

hook_placement.note: model's own final output vs the same quantity rebuilt from the hooked last block (|diff| <= 1e-3 x max(1, output scale))
